name: Ritz-Carlton Maldives, Fari Islands
positioning: Island resort on the Fari Islands in North Male Atoll, with circular villas that each have a private infinity pool (official name: The Ritz-Carlton Maldives, Fari Islands)
best_for: Travelers who want a private pool villa with a dedicated island butler
Families, since Ritz Kids gives young guests their own space

facts.text: The resort has seven restaurants and bars across the Culinary Island, Grand Sunset Beach and Fari Marina Village.
Each beach and water villa has a private infinity pool.
Every villa has a dedicated Aris Meeha, or island butler, who is available around the clock.
The Ritz-Carlton Spa is a ring-shaped building set over the lagoon.
The resort is on the Fari Islands, a man-made archipelago in North Male Atoll.
La Locanda serves Southern Italian cuisine.
Private dining can be arranged at Mystique Garden, Grand Sunset Beach, Beach Cove or Sandback.
The villas run mainly on solar power, and the resort is single plastic-free.
Fari Marina Village has a beach club, boutiques, an art installation by James Turrell and upscale restaurants.
Ritz Kids gives young guests their own space, where playtime can mean video games or a dip in the dedicated outdoor pool.

highlights.text: At sunset, Bodu Beru drummers perform a ceremony that honors the oldest surviving tradition of the Maldives, followed by a flaming ceremony.
The circular villas were designed by Kerry Hill Architects, who are known for many of Aman's resorts.
The resort brought in Jean-Michel Cousteau's Ambassadors of the Environment to lead its marine education and exploration program.
A drone conservation project monitors the ocean habitat for turtles entangled in abandoned fishing nets, known as ghost nets.

considerations.text: The resort is a 45-minute boat ride from Velana International Airport.
Venue closing days at the restaurants may change seasonally.
Overwater villa stays have an age restriction of 13 and up, though parents or guardians can sign a waiver when booking.
